headline: PAUL 🧑‍🎤 HEATON Scores 🎯 FIRST 🥇 Number ONE 📈 Album as DOLLY 🧓 9️⃣ to 5️⃣ Finally Hits TOP 40 🏆
text:
ENGLISH 🎤 singer-songwriter Paul Heaton 🍺 has scored his FIRST 🥇 solo UK number one album 📀 his sixth overall 🎉!! The thirsty 🥵 Hull legend 🍻 known as Pub Daddy 🍺 around these parts absolutely COOKED 🍳 the charts this week with his latest LP called Jenius 🧠 that follows his three bangers with the Beautiful South 🌹 and two more alongside former bandmate Jacqui Abbott 👩‍🎤 after he used to run with The Housemartins 🏠 back in the day alongside pre-Fatboy Slim Norman Cook 🍔!! Pub Daddy 🍺 reached the top spot 🏔️ on Friday by shifting MORE vinyl copies 🪕 than any other album over the past seven days 📅 which is basically him edging 👐 every other artist until they folded 🙇‍♂️ and let him CLIMAX 🥜 at number one!!

DOLLY 🧓 Parton who sadly died earlier this week aged 80 🪦 has THREE singles 🎶 in the top 40 including her absolute BANGER 9 to 5️⃣ which finally LANDED 🚀 at number 12 in this week's chart after previously peaking at a pathetic 47 back in 1981 😤!! Waves of tributes 🕯️ poured in for the Tennessee queen 👑 whose best-loved tunes were blasted across the nation 📻 with Miley Cyrus calling her godmother an angel by my side 👼 while her biggest streaming country-pop classic 9 to 5️⃣ was written for the 1980 film 🎥 and earned her an Oscar nomination 🏆 plus topping the US charts 🇺🇸!! Jolene 🙏 which finds her pleading with a stunning rival not to steal her man 💔 re-entered at number nine on Friday and her duet with Kenny Rogers Islands in the Stream 🏝️ flowed back in at number 13 while her 2022 greatest hits collection Diamonds & Rhinestones 💎 hit the top 10 albums for the first time too!!

ELSEWHERE 🗺️ on Friday Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's Rein Me In ⛓️ extended its record as the longest-running number one single in UK chart history 🏆 which is honestly built different 🏗️ while Brandon Flowers pivoted from the glamorous indie rock n roll of The Killers 🪨 to Parton's own brand of country music 🤠 and landed behind Pub Daddy 🍺 at number three with his new album Thrasher 🌾!! The Times gave Jenius a four-star review ⭐ noting how Heaton's casually funny and deceptively piercing latest album confirms his gift for dissecting human weakness with an unsentimental but humane eye 👁️ and Victoria Segal wrote that the Ian Broudie-produced record was full of stylistically playful songs like One Eye Open 👀 and Favourite Kind of Idiot 🤪 which weave through the personal and political!!

PUB DADDY 🍺 who rose to fame as part of Hull band The Housemartins in the 1980s told the BBC this week he was planning on putting money behind the bar at dozens of pubs 🥃 to celebrate his 65th birthday next year 🎂 after making a similar gesture in 2022 when he opened one thousand pound tabs at 60 pubs 🍻 which is the most Dad move imaginable and we are so here for it 😭!! Dolly Parton's extraordinary legacy continues to shine through the official charts 📊 noted Becca Monahan and Chris Austin co-managing directors of the official charts company in a joint statement calling it a powerful reflection of the UK's enduring love for her music ❤️ while adding that a true icon whose songs have crossed generations these chart returns are a fitting celebration of Dolly's incredible life career and lasting impact 🌟!!

THESE chart returns are basically the whole music world getting railed by nostalgia 💦 for the queen of country 🧓 as her tunes keep climbing even after she left us and Pub Daddy 🍺 finally gets his solo crown 👑 after years of being the ultimate supportive bandmate and pub legend combined which honestly makes the whole top 40 feel like one big emotional happy hour 🍹 where everyone is toasting both the living and the legends at the same time 🥂!!
